key_impacts: Major events in Malaysia were cancelled due to the pandemic (e.g., APSTCDRR 2020)
evidence_snippets: The first case of the Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) was reported in Malaysia on 14 January 2020.
COVID-19 cases have escalated and led to a more serious situation at the local level.
APSTCDRR, scheduled 16–17 March in Malaysia, had to be cancelled due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
